class.name: VCSVTable
class.brief_description:
Low-level data container: a header row plus a grid of string rows.
低层数据容器：一个表头行加字符串网格。
class.description:
Produced by [VCSVParser]; holds [member headers] (may be empty when [VCSVParseOptions.has_header] is off) and [member rows] (data rows only). Provides cell/row/column access and conversions to [Array] of [Dictionary]. Use [VCSVDataTable] when you need typed rows.
由 [VCSVParser] 产生；保存 [member headers]（[VCSVParseOptions.has_header] 关闭时可为空）和 [member rows]（仅数据行）。提供单元格/行/列访问及 [Array] of [Dictionary] 转换。需要类型化行时使用 [VCSVDataTable]。

method.name: set_data
method.description:
Replaces headers and data rows (rows must NOT include the header row).
替换表头和数据行（rows 不得包含表头行）。

method.name: get_headers
method.description:
Header names (empty when no header row).
表头名（无表头行时为空）。

method.name: get_rows
method.description:
Data rows as [PackedStringArray] entries.
数据行（元素为 [PackedStringArray]）。

method.name: get_header
method.description:
Alias for [method get_headers].
[method get_headers] 的别名。

method.name: get_name
method.description:
Optional table name.
可选表名。

method.name: set_name
method.description:
Sets the optional table name.
设置可选表名。

method.name: get_row_count
method.description:
Number of data rows.
数据行数。

method.name: get_col_count
method.description:
Number of columns (header count, or the widest row).
列数（表头数，或最宽行）。

method.name: is_empty
method.description:
Whether there are no data rows.
是否没有数据行。

method.name: get_row
method.description:
Returns the row at [param index] (empty if out of range).
返回第 [param index] 行（越界返回空）。

method.name: get_value
method.description:
Returns one cell; [param col] is an int index or a String header name.
返回一个单元格；[param col] 为 int 下标或 String 表头名。

method.name: get_row_dict
method.description:
Returns header→cell for the row (numeric keys when no headers).
返回该行的 header→cell（无表头时用数字键）。

method.name: to_dict_array
method.description:
All rows as an [Array] of [Dictionary].
所有行转 [Array] of [Dictionary]。

method.name: has_column
method.description:
Whether a header column [param name] exists.
是否存在名为 [param name] 的表头列。

method.name: column_index
method.description:
Index of header column [param name], or [code]-1[/code].
表头列 [param name] 的下标，或 [code]-1[/code]。

method.name: sort
method.description:
Sorts the data rows in place by the cell values of [param column] (an int index or a String header name). When [param numeric] is [code]true[/code], cells are compared as numbers (non-numeric cells sort as 0); otherwise lexicographically.
按 [param column]（int 下标或 String 表头名）就地排序数据行。[param numeric] 为 [code]true[/code] 时按数值比较（非数值按 0）；否则按字典序。

method.name: find
method.description:
Returns the indices of rows whose [param column] cell matches [param value] per [param match_mode] (a [enum MatchMode] value).
返回 [param column] 单元格按 [param match_mode]（[enum MatchMode] 值）匹配 [param value] 的行下标。

method.name: find_first
method.description:
Returns the first matching row index, or [code]-1[/code].
返回首个匹配行下标，或 [code]-1[/code]。

method.name: find_where
method.description:
Returns the indices of rows for which [code]predicate.call(row_cells)[/code] is truthy ([param row_cells] is the row as a [PackedStringArray]).
返回 [code]predicate.call(row_cells)[/code] 为真的行下标（[param row_cells] 是 [PackedStringArray] 形式的行）。

method.name: add_row
method.description:
Appends a row (elements stringified) and returns its index.
追加一行（元素转为字符串）并返回其下标。

method.name: remove_row
method.description:
Removes the row at [param index] (rows shift down). Returns [code]false[/code] if out of range.
删除第 [param index] 行（后续行上移）。越界返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: set_cell
method.description:
Sets one cell; [param col] is an int index or a String header name.
设置一个单元格；[param col] 为 int 下标或 String 表头名。

method.name: get_distinct
method.description:
Unique cell values of [param column] in first-occurrence order (empty cells skipped).
[param column] 的唯一边界值，按首次出现顺序（跳过空单元格）。

method.name: get_column
method.description:
All cell values of [param column] as raw strings, in row order.
[param column] 每行的单元格值（原始字符串，按行序）。

method.name: to_json_string
method.description:
Serializes the table to a JSON array-of-dictionaries string (column order preserved).
把表序列化为 JSON 字典数组字符串（保持列顺序）。

method.name: from_dict_array
method.description:
Builds a table from an [Array] of [Dictionary] rows; column order follows [param column_order], or the first dict's keys. Cell values are stringified.
从 [Dictionary] 的 [Array] 构建表；列序跟随 [param column_order] 或首个字典的键。单元格值转为字符串。

method.name: from_json_string
method.description:
Builds a table from a JSON array-of-dictionaries string.
从 JSON 字典数组字符串构建表。

members.member:
Optional table name.
